req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* is present on ALL responses. To achieve high mutation kill rate, tests must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence, (2) cover multiple endpoints to confirm universality, (3) test that the header is absent when the CORS middleware is removed (negative path via a non-CORS endpoint simulation), (4) test boundary conditions like redirect responses and error responses, and (5) verify the exact string '*' to catch mutations like '' or 'null'. Each test imports the Flask app in-process and uses test_client().

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers
    assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint()

Assert Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' not the echoed origin
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin == '*' (wildcard, not the specific origin sent)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: value must be '*' not a reflected origin; BVA on exact constant value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Origin': 'https://example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != 'https://example.com'
    assert val != 'example.com'

test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin()

tests.name: test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: 'all responses' — decision table covering all HTTP method endpoints
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
        ('GET', '/headers'),
        ('GET', '/cookies'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
        assert val == '*', f"Expected '*' on {method} {path}, got {val!r}"

test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table()
